ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, directors, and legal representatives against (i) the Viet Nam Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) PEP database maintained under the State Bank of Viet Nam; (ii) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (iii) the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List; (iv) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Database; (v) the UK OFSI Consolidated Sanctions List; and (vi) the domestic administrative and criminal sanction lists published by Viet Nam authorities. Enhanced due diligence is required where any UBO holds 25% or more of capital, where the subscriber is non-resident, or where the investor is from a jurisdiction identified by FATF as strategically deficient. Beneficial ownership information is verified against the enterprise register and the national electronic information portal; discrepancies trigger suspension of the incorporation application.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp) – https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Enterprise names must be written in Vietnamese using the Latin alphabet (Romanized script with Vietnamese diacritical marks) and be pronounceable in Vietnamese. The name must consist of a trade name (main title) and may include a corporate business form suffix such as 'Trách Nhiệm Hữu Hạn' or 'TNHH'. A company may also register an abbreviated/transliterated name in Han script (Han tu) or Latin letters, but the primary registered name must not rely solely on a foreign-language construction. The name must not duplicate or be confused with an already-registered enterprise name and must not use names of state bodies, ministries, mass organizations, or military and security units without prior written consent. Trademark conflicts are also screened through the National Business Registration Portal and industrial property databases.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bộ Công Thương (Ministry of Industry and Trade)
tài chính (finance, where requiring ministerial license)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a name rejection, the applicant receives a written notice from the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) stating the ground for refusal. The applicant may (i) revise and resubmit the proposed name through the National Business Registration Portal within the original dossier window; or (ii) file an administrative complaint with the Director of the DPI under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13. The complaint must be filed within 90 days of receiving the rejection notice, and the DPI Director must issue a decision within 30 days of receipt. If the administrative appeal is unsuccessful, the applicant may initiate a judicial appeal before the provincial Administrative Court under the Law on Administrative Proceedings No. 93/2015/QH13 within one year of the appeal decision or within the statute of limitations applicable to administrative litigation. An extension of name reservation is generally not available; the applicant must submit a fresh name-reservation application once the 30-day window lapses.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices and co-working addresses are moderately tolerated in major business centers (Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang) for low-risk service entities such as a design subscription agency, provided that the applicant holds a valid lease agreement or service-level agreement with the premises owner and the address is a real, physical, serviceable location where records can be accessed. Pure mail-forwarding addresses or addresses lacking owner consent and a written lease are not acceptable to the DPI and create a risk of registration annulment under the Law on Enterprises. The General Department of Taxation and DPI may separately cross-check the registered office against VAT and enterprise income tax filing substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% – Unannounced physical on-site inspections by the DPI and local taxation authorities are estimated at a low-to-moderate probability (approximately one in six) within the first 24 months following incorporation for an ISIC 7410 design subscription entity, based on provincial enforcement discretion, invoice-basis risk, and the prevalence of shell-company scrutiny in the target jurisdiction.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, Articles 9, 22, 25-31, 46-47 and 52-55; Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 36-38 and 44; Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP on investment registration
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) under the Provincial People's Committee (e.g., Hanoi DPI, Ho Chi Minh City DPI); for enterprises located in an export processing zone, industrial zone or economic zone, the Management Board of such zone (Ban Quản lý các Khu Công nghiệp / Khu Chế xuất)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Enterprise Registration Application (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) submitted together with the Investment Registration Certificate application (for foreign investors), the Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty), the List of Members (Danh sách thành viên) and the standard Form I-1 and Form I-2 declarations under Decree 01/2021/ND-CP
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to a foreign-invested LLC providing office-based UI/UX design subscription services under ISIC 7410. The charter capital is freely declared by the members in Vietnamese Dong; it must be fully contributed within ninety (90) days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (Article 47, Law on Enterprises 2020). No escrow account or pre-funded bank verification account is required by the registry at incorporation; however, contributed capital must be remitted through a licensed commercial bank in Vietnam and recorded in the Company's statutory accounting books. If the enterprise later elects export processing enterprise (EPE) status, investment capital contribution is subject to the compliance schedule under the Law on Investment and its implementing decrees.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST DECISION AND CORPORATE GOVERNANCE RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDING MEMBERS / MEMBERS' COUNCIL OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY

Adopted on [Date] at [Registered Office Address], Viet Nam, by the unanimous written consent of all founding members of the Company (the 'Members').

WHEREAS, the Company is being established as a foreign-invested limited liability company under the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam;

WHEREAS, the Company's registered business scope is product interface design, UI/UX design, and design-as-a-service subscription agency services under ISIC 7410 and NAICS 541430;

WHEREAS, the Members deem it necessary to formalize the initial corporate governance, capital subscription, registered office, officer appointments, and banking arrangements of the Company.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Members hereby resolve as follows:

1. CHARTER CAPITAL AND SUBSCRIPTION: The charter capital of the Company is fixed at VND [amount] (USD [amount] equivalent), divided among the Members in the proportions set out in the List of Members filed with the Department of Planning and Investment. Each Member irrevocably subscribes to the capital contribution portion ascribed to that Member and shall contribute such amount in full no later than the ninetieth (90th) day following the issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. Contributions may be made in cash, in kind, or in lawful intangible assets, and shall be recorded in the Company's charter capital ledger and statutory Member Contribution Register.

2. REGISTERED OFFICE: The registered office of the Company is hereby adopted at [full street address, ward, district, province/city, Viet Nam]. The legal representative shall file any change of registered office with the competent Department of Planning and Investment within ten (10) days of any subsequent members' decision.

3. APPONTMENT OF LEGAL REPRESENTATIVE AND OFFICERS: [Full name, passport/ID number, residential address] is hereby appointed as the sole legal representative and General Director (Tổng giám đốc) of the Company, with full power to sign contracts, open bank accounts, hire personnel, approve ordinary operating expenditures within authorized limits, and represent the Company before all state agencies. [Full name, accountant license number] is hereby appointed as Chief Accountant with responsibility for the lawful preparation of financial statements and tax filings under the Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14.

4. BANKING AND SUBSCRIPTION PAYMENT RAILS: The General Director is directed to open corporate current accounts, in both VND and USD, at a licensed commercial bank in Viet Nam, and to configure the recurring billing and subscription collection engines (including Stripe Billing and Wise) so that all subscription fees are settled into the corporate bank account after deduction of gateway charges. All foreign currency receivables shall be recorded in the Company's foreign currency account and reported to the servicing bank in accordance with the State Bank of Vietnam's foreign exchange control regulations applicable to cross-border service payments.

5. CORPORATE SEAL AND GOVERNANCE RECORDS: The Company shall establish its corporate seal and file the seal specimen with the National Business Registration System pursuant to Decree 01/2021/ND-CP. The Company shall maintain a member register, minutes of members' meetings, charter capital ledger, contract file, and statutory accounting books from the date of the Enterprise Registration Certificate.

6. INITIAL TAX FILING OBLIGATION: The Chief Accountant shall file the first monthly value-added tax declaration (nil declaration) covering the period from Enterprise Registration Certificate issuance until the commencement of taxable revenue, and shall register for electronic invoice service on the General Department of Taxation portal concurrently with the opening of the Company's bank account.

7. EFFECTIVE DATE: This Resolution is effective immediately upon adoption and constitutes the first corporate governance act and founding resolution of the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) Application for Foreign Investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province/city where the Company is located; for entities located in an export processing zone, industrial zone, or economic zone, the Management Board of the respective zone
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign investor submits an Investment Project Registration application through the National Investment Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) or directly at the DPI investment registration counter. Because the Company is a services enterprise not seeking investment policy approval, the DPI reviews the dossier in the standard registration track and issues the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC). The application must describe the lawful project objectives, scale, location (premises identification), total investment capital, charter capital, financing plan, and the expected project implementation schedule. All foreign-language documents must be accompanied by certified Vietnamese translations, and any foreign entity documents must be consular legalized unless the investor's country is exempt under a treaty.
required_dossiers: Written request for investment project registration (standard Form I-1)
Investment project proposal describing objectives, scale, capital, site and implementation schedule
Legal status certificate of the foreign investor (certified copy of certificate of incorporation or equivalent, legalized/translated)
Financial capacity report (audited financial statements for the most recent two fiscal years or a bank confirmation of available funds from a licensed bank)
Copy or letter of intent for the office/leased premises in Viet Nam
Power of attorney and identity documents of the authorized signatory
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a written request for correction, the investor must remedy the deficiencies within thirty (30) days from the date of the notice. If the investor fails to cure within the deadline, the application is administratively rejected; the investor may file a new application after curing the defects, or may submit a written appeal to the provincial People's Committee within thirty days of rejection under administrative procedure law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) Issuance for the Limited Liability Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) or the Management Board of the relevant industrial/export processing zone; operation through the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.vn)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after the IRC is granted, the investor submits the Enterprise Registration Application online or physically at the DPI. The filing must declare the Company's name (with a proposed alternative name in case of conflict), the principal business lines (product interface design and digital design subscription agency services), the registered office, charter capital, members' contribution schedule, and the legal representative. Electronic submission must be authenticated with a digital signature or verified by notarized paper copies submitted in person. The DPI will issue the Enterprise Registration Certificate (which simultaneously constitutes the tax identification code and business legal personality) within three working days of receiving a valid dossier. The ERC and IRC may be issued simultaneously in one application if the investor has so elected.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Application (Form I-1) signed by the investor or authorised attorney
Company Charter approved by all founding members
List of Members with contribution amounts and contribution schedules (Form I-2)
Valid Investment Registration Certificate (issued under Step 1)
Certified copies of legal status documents of each member (passport for individuals; certificate of incorporation for legal entities, with legalization/translation)
Declaration of legal representative appointment with certified identity documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ERC dossier is queried (e.g., company name collision, incomplete member documents, or defective Charter), the DPI notifies the applicant of required corrections. The applicant must rectify the dossier within thirty (30) days; failure to do so results in dismissal of the application, without prejudice to the right to file a fresh application. If the DPI rejects the application, the applicant may complain to the provincial People's Committee or initiate administrative court proceedings under the Law on Complaints.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Creation, Seal Specimen Filing, Bank Account Opening, and Tax Portal Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (seal specimen management via the National Business Registration Portal); licensed commercial bank in Viet Nam; General Department of Taxation (via the electronic invoice and tax portals)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the ERC is issued, the Company engages a licensed seal engraving enterprise to create its corporate seal, then submits the seal specimen online through the National Business Registration Portal (or by post) for posting on the national enterprise registration database. Simultaneously, the legal representative, acting under the First Board Resolution, visits a licensed commercial bank to open corporate VND and USD demand deposit or current accounts, presenting the IRC, ERC, seal specimen, resolution, and the passport of the signatory; the bank's customer due diligence staff will perform beneficial ownership verification under the State Bank of Vietnam's anti-money laundering rules. Upon receipt of bank account confirmation, the Company registers for the electronic tax system (eTax), the electronic invoice portal (hoadon.gov.vn), and secures the digital signature certificate from a licensed certificate provider for lawful e-invoicing.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Investment Registration Certificate
First Board Resolution appointing the legal representative and opening bank accounts
Corporate seal specimen confirmation from the National Business Registration System
Passport and residence proof of the legal representative and signatories
Lease agreement or certificate of registered office use
Beneficial ownership declaration and bank KYC forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank delays or refuses account opening due to insufficient beneficial ownership documentation, the Company must supply the necessary organizational chart and ultimate beneficial owner declarations, after which the bank must process the application in conformity with its internal due diligence timelines; refusal may be cured by applying to another licensed bank with a fully compliant dossier. If the seal specimen submission is rejected by the DPI portal, the submission may be repeated after correcting the scanned file format, and a written hard copy may be filed in person at the DPI office if the portal application is technically blocked.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fire Prevention and Workplace Occupational Safety Clearance for the Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Fire Prevention and Rescue Police Department (PC07) under the provincial police; local Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA) for occupational safety records
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Company confirms that the leased office is housed in a building that holds a valid Fire Prevention and Fire Fighting acceptance certificate issued under Law on Fire Prevention and Fighting and Rescue No. 56/2024/QH15 and Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP (as amended). The Company itself must also complete a fire safety dossier for its fit-out: install and maintain portable fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, and exit signage; prepare a workplace fire prevention and evacuation plan; and deliver fire safety training to personnel. The competent fire police may conduct a physical inspection of the premises before issuing a fire safety clearance certificate or endorsement. The Company simultaneously registers its occupational hygiene and safety plan with DOLISA, includes annual health checks for employees, and adopts a workplace safety policy aligned with Law No. 84/2015/QH13.
required_dossiers: Copy of the Enterprise Registration Certificate
Lease agreement and the lessor's building fire acceptance certificate
Fire prevention and extinguishing system layout for the fitted office
Staff fire safety training records
First Board Resolution approving the fire safety budget and responsible officer
Occupational safety and hygiene plan (with risk assessment for computer-based workstations)
List of employees and their designated evacuation roles
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire police identify deficiencies, a rectification notice specifies the corrective works; the Company must complete the required equipment installation and staff training, then submit a written completion report to request re-inspection. Re-inspection is typically completed within fifteen (15) days of the completion notice. Failure to obtain clearance may lead to an administrative fine and suspension of the office's occupancy; appeals may be filed with the provincial People's Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Invoice Registration, External Subscription Payment Rail Integration, and Initial Tax Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Department of Taxation (local tax sub-department); licensed commercial bank; State Bank of Vietnam (indirectly through the reporting bank); services technology provider of Stripe Billing and Wise
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Company, through its General Director and Chief Accountant, activates its electronic invoice account on hoadon.gov.vn and receives an e-invoice serial code before issuing any subscription invoice. The Company then configures the recurring subscription contracts on its Stripe Billing account (using the merchant entity structure legally acceptable under Vietnamese law and the payment service provider's terms) and the Wise payout route, ensuring that each settlement entry is remitted to the corporate bank account and that all cross-border receipts are reported through the bank's foreign exchange reporting system. The Company must finalize its first VAT return, even if nil, for the period from ERC issuance to the end of the first month, and must thereafter file VAT and corporate income tax declarations as applicable. Subscription billing must be structured so that each charge is evidenced by a valid e-invoice issued within the statutory time limit.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate
Bank account opening confirmation from the licensed bank
Electronic invoice registration form and digital signature certificate
Completed e-Tax registration confirmation
First Board Resolution approving the subscription payment configuration and authorized signatory
Business process description of the design subscription service and billing model
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority withholds the e-invoice serial allocation because of incomplete registration or outstanding prior filings, the Company must immediately file any missing nil declarations and resubmit the registration; the allocation is processed within one working day after compliance. If Stripe or Wise cannot onboard the Vietnamese entity directly due to payment network licensing restrictions, the Company must use a compliant third-party payment intermediary holding a State Bank of Vietnam license or invoice through an eligible offshore group sales entity, while ensuring the Vietnamese entity records the service revenue in its Vietnamese tax books; the bank's foreign exchange desk shall be consulted for documentation of permitted cross-border service payments.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for an office-based design subscription agency under ISIC 7410; no industrial production or manufacturing registration is required. If the Company later expands into tangible production, warehousing or light assembly, the competent industrial licensing board would be the Department of Industry and Trade (Sở Công Thương) or the Management Board of the relevant industrial zone.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required. The statutory permission to operate is constituted by the Investment Registration Certificate and the Enterprise Registration Certificate; no separate industrial operating license is imposed on UI/UX design advisory and subscription services. Any additional license would apply only for incidental activities such as software export reporting under Decree No. 66/2025/ND-CP or data processing regulations, but not as an industrial operation license.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) for national-level projects; Provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) for provincial supervision; no EIA agency involvement for exempt service activities
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Not Subject to Environmental Impact Assessment. Pure design subscription services are not listed in the EIA screening categories of Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP; no Environmental Permit (Giấy phép môi trường) is required for a leased office whose daily wastewater discharge remains below the statutory threshold of 500 m3/day and which uses municipal infrastructure.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharge or VOC emissions arise from the activity. The Company must nonetheless comply with the following general thresholds: (i) domestic wastewater discharged to the municipal sewerage system shall meet the municipal collection requirements or QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT for domestic wastewater parameters; (ii) office indoor air quality shall meet QCVN 06:2022/BXD for thermal, ventilation and CO2 parameters; (iii) electronic waste, spent ink/toner cartridges, batteries and discarded subscriber hardware (if any) shall be handed over to licensed recycling facilities under the extended producer responsibility regime of Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP; and (iv) any digital design files stored in data centers shall be managed under the cybersecurity and personal data protection requirements of Decree No. 13/2023/ND-CP and relevant technical regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name_note: If the Company later adds a small product prototyping workshop involving surface coating or chemical solvents, a Category III environmental registration with DONRE would be triggered, together with compliance with QCVN 06:2022/BXD and national wastewater standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Prevention and Fighting clearance administered by the provincial Fire Prevention and Rescue Police under Law on Fire Prevention and Fighting and Rescue No. 56/2024/QH15 and Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP (as amended by Decree No. 83/2024/ND-CP). The Company must hold or rely on the lessor's certificate of fire safety acceptance for the building, maintain fire extinguishers, emergency exits and adequate lighting, and evidence an annual fire escape drill and staff training register. Occupational safety clearance is registered with the provincial Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs under Law No. 84/2015/QH13, including ergonomic evaluation of computer workstations, annual health examination of employees, and designation of an occupational safety officer. No structural load inspection is required because the Company undertakes no structural modification of the leased premises; if the Company modifies load-bearing structures or mezzanines, a construction permit and technical appraisal by the Department of Construction would become mandatory under Decree No. 15/2021/ND-CP.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế) under the Ministry of Finance of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam; primary business portals: https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn (electronic tax declaration and payment) and https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn (national e-invoice clearance portal); enterprise incorporation flanks via the National Enterprise Registration Information System at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn operated by the Ministry of Planning and Investment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested Limited Liability Company receives its statutory tax identification number (Mã số thuế, 10-digit MST) automatically upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate by the provincial Department of Planning and Investment or the relevant Economic Zone / Industrial Zone Authority; no separate tax authority pre-approval is required. Procedure: (1) obtain the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) via https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn, processing within 3–15 working days; the ERC states the MST, which is simultaneously activated in the GDT taxpayer registry; (2) within 10 working days of the ERC, file supplementary tax registration information, open a foreign-currency and VND bank account at a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank, and declare the legal representative and authorized signatories; (3) obtain a qualified e-signature certificate (chữ ký số) from a licensed certification authority; (4) register the e-invoice issuing method through a certified e-invoice service provider or direct GDT portal API; (5) register the VAT declaration cycle (monthly or quarterly where annual revenue is below VND 50 billion) and the corporate income tax finalization cycle; (6) pay the annual business license fee (Lệ phí môn bài) under Decree 22/2020/ND-CP — VND 2,000,000 for charter capital ≤ VND 10 billion, VND 3,000,000 above, VND 1,000,000 per branch, with first-year exemption.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vietnam administers no US-style check-the-box election and no domestic hybrid-mismatch election; a foreign-invested LLC is per se a resident enterprise taxed at entity level on worldwide income at the standard 20% corporate income tax rate. Available statutory elections and mechanisms include: (i) VAT computation method election — the credit (deduction) method is compulsory for enterprises keeping full accounting records, while the direct-on-added-value method is statutorily available only to micro taxpayers with revenue below the threshold; (ii) election to offset prior-year tax losses against future taxable income within 5 consecutive years (non-discretionary election to preserve the loss benefit); (iii) foreign tax credit election under an applicable double taxation treaty, filed via Form 01/TNT with GDT confirmation; (iv) for related-party transactions, election to prepare a simplified transfer-pricing file under Circular 132/2020/TT-BTC when intercompany transactions and Belgian-style thresholds are met; (v) no election to be treated as a transparent entity exists, and the 30% EBITDA interest deduction cap applies mandatorily where financing is used.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) – Thuế Giá Trị Gia Tăng (standard rate 10%; reduced rate 5% for enumerated supply categories; 0% for qualified exports of goods and offshore-consumed services)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VND 0 for all limited liability companies — every foreign-invested LLC, regardless of forecast turnover, must register for VAT immediately upon incorporation and file periodic VAT returns. The only statutory turnover exemption is VND 100,000,000 per year, and it applies exclusively to household businesses and individual sole proprietors, not to LLC legal entities. A quarterly VAT declaration window is available where annual revenue is below VND 50 billion, but registration itself is unconditional.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory since 1 July 2022 under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. Every recurrent design-subscription invoice must be an e-invoice in GDT-prescribed XML/TXML format bearing a qualified digital signature and a sequential invoice-symbol/number. Two clearance paths exist: (a) e-invoices with Tax Authority Code — invoice data is transmitted via a certified e-invoice service provider or direct GDT portal API and a validated GDT code is returned in near-real-time before legal issuance, constituting effective fiscal clearance; and (b) self-generated e-invoices (with code) — authorized enterprises issue invoices under their own sequence and must transmit invoice data to the national e-invoice portal within 5 days of issuance (aggregation permitted with GDT approval). The digital stamp is the enterprise's qualified e-signature; no physical fiscal stamp is used. E-invoice data must reconcile with the monthly VAT return (Form 01/GTGT) and the annual CIT finalization; mismatch triggers automatic GDT red-flag analysis.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to UI/UX design and digital design subscription services (ISIC 7410) supplied to a foreign customer if and only if all statutory conditions of Article 9, Decree 209/2013/ND-CP and Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC are cumulatively met: (i) the service recipient is a foreign organization or individual that does not have a permanent establishment in Vietnam in respect of the subscribed design services; (ii) the design service is actually consumed outside Vietnam — the deliverable library, design system, UI asset files, and UX specifications must be deployed or used for the client's operations outside Vietnamese territory, evidenced by acceptance certificates, IP assignment/licenses, time-stamped digital handover records (e.g., Figma, Jira, GitHub access logs), and overseas project correspondence; (iii) payment is received from abroad in convertible foreign currency through a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank, with clean SWIFT/MT103 inflows traceable to the foreign client; subscription settlements routed via Stripe Billing or Wise must ultimately land in the LLC's foreign-currency account at a Vietnamese bank — if the collection chain is deemed to occur in Vietnam in VND through a local payment aggregator, the 0% condition fails and 10% VAT is due; (iv) the LLC maintains a complete export-service dossier containing the subscription agreement, e-invoice, acceptance evidence, and foreign currency remittance certificates. Input VAT attributable to the exported service is fully creditable and refundable on a monthly/quarterly basis, with refund claims subject to pre-refund GDT examination. Services performed in Vietnam for consumption in Vietnam — such as local user-testing workshops for a domestic audience — do not qualify for 0% and are taxed at 10%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export service contract (Hợp đồng dịch vụ xuất khẩu) with the foreign subscriber, specifying the scope of UI/UX subscription deliverables, offshore consumption, payment currency, and settlement rails
Recurring e-invoice for each subscription billing cycle issued in conformity with Decree 123/2020/ND-CP, showing 0% VAT and a clear reference to the underlying export contract
Certificate of completion / acceptance handover (Biên bản nghiệm thu) electronically signed or acknowledged by the foreign client, evidencing receipt and offshore utilization of design deliverables

Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or original bank statement issued by the Vietnamese commercial bank confirming receipt of each subscription payment in convertible foreign currency from an overseas bank account within the statutory period

Proof of offshore consumption: time-stamped deliverable access logs (Figma, GitHub, Miro), IP transfer or license documents, cloud deployment certificates, and client-side correspondence demonstrating utilization outside Vietnamese territory

For any physical deliverables or software media that accompany the electronic design subscription: customs export declaration (Tờ khai hải quan), commercial packing list, bill of lading or airway bill
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export-service zero-rating is a high-audit-risk area for the GDT, especially for recurring digital subscriptions, because eligibility rests on subjective offshore-consumption evidence. Penalties under the Law on Tax Administration 2019 and Penal Code 2015 (amended 2017) include: (i) late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on any VAT under-declared; (ii) administrative sanctions of up to 3 times the evaded tax amount for fraudulent zero-rating declarations; (iii) full retrospective clawback of input VAT previously credited against export sales, reversal of output VAT at the 10% standard rate, and disallowance for CIT of related expenditures; (iv) criminal prosecution under Article 200 for tax evasion from VND 100 million, carrying fines and imprisonment of up to 7 years (or higher where aggravated amounts exceed VND 1 billion); (v) suspension or revocation of e-invoice self-issuance rights, migration to the Tax Authority Code regime, and downgrading of the taxpayer compliance rating, which triggers mandatory 100% pre-refund audit for all subsequent VAT refund claims; (vi) in the cross-border subscription scenario, GDT scrutiny of the Stripe/Wise payment chain may also reclassify net settlement flows as taxable commission income unless the merchant-of-record and foreign-exchange traceability documentation is clear.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) (Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam). The SBV holds exclusive authority over monetary policy, foreign exchange administration, cross-border payment supervision, and the licensing of authorized banks, credit institutions, and foreign exchange dealers in the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vietnamese dong (VND) is conditionally convertible. Current account transactions, including service export proceeds, subscription fees, software licensing, and profit remittances arising from permissible underlyings, are generally convertible without prior SBV approval, provided they are supported by verifiable commercial documents and settled through authorized credit institutions. Capital account transactions, including inbound foreign direct investment contributions, shareholder loans, and repatriation of invested capital upon liquidation, are subject to stricter SBV registration, approval, and reporting obligations and must flow through the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) of the foreign-invested LLC. Profit remittance after the first year of operation is permitted once the annual financial statements are audited, tax liabilities are settled and evidenced by tax clearance or payment receipts, and a board resolution authorizing the distribution is issued. In practice, full and immediate convertibility cannot be assumed for capital outflows; advance consultation with the servicing licensed bank and the SBV-supervised foreign investment monitoring system is mandatory.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Vietnam's Foreign Exchange Ordinance and Decree 70/2014/ND-CP, as implemented by SBV Circular 05/2021/TT-NHNN, a resident organization exporting goods or services must receive all export proceeds through authorized credit institutions and repatriate those proceeds to its foreign currency account at an authorized bank within 90 days from the date of service completion (or customs clearance for goods, or the date of the export invoice for services, whichever is later under the relevant underlying contract). There is no mandatory surrender ratio currently applicable to export receipts in convertible foreign currencies; the LLC may retain the foreign currency in its account or sell it to the authorized bank at the prevailing market exchange rate. For design-subscription services delivered to overseas clients, the LLC must ensure that subscription collections, whether received directly or via digital payment facilitators, ultimately settle into the bank account of the Vietnamese entity within the 90-day statutory timeline and are properly reported with the corresponding service-export transaction purpose code.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules_note: If export proceeds are retained in foreign currency, the LLC must separately manage its VND working capital requirements and any foreign-currency loan repayments; conversion to VND is permissible through the authorized bank at the approximate market exchange rate, subject to SBV exchange-rate band regulations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (DICA) and Operational Account (VND/foreign currency)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam (BIDV)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (DICA) and Operational Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Industry and Trade (VietinBank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (DICA) and Operational Account
Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account (under specific branch authority)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW AS A BANK ACCOUNT SUBSTITUTE; MODERATE AS A COLLECTIONS-ONLY FACILITATOR. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Stripe, Payoneer, Airwallex) are not licensed credit institutions under Vietnam's Law on Credit Institutions and cannot receive statutory FDI capital contributions or act as the primary bank account for the LLC. SBV foreign-exchange regulations require export service proceeds and capital account flows to be received through an authorized bank in Vietnam; therefore, using an offshore EMI as the principal treasury account would constitute a breach of the Foreign Exchange Ordinance and the AML law, exposing the entity to fines, suspension of banking privileges, and criminal exposure in severe cases. EMIs may be used only as operational gateways for receiving low-value subscription collections, provided all funds are swept into the Vietnamese authorized bank account within the 90-day export-receipt window and are correctly mapped to the underlying service-export purpose code. Any direct delinking of subscription billing from a Vietnamese bank account is not compliant.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of at least one authorized signatory is generally mandatory for a foreign-invested LLC. The legal representative or a director of the LLC, or a person holding a notarized power of attorney with Vietnamese translation, must appear in person at the chosen bank branch to execute the account-opening agreement, sign the AML/KYC questionnaire, and present original corporate documents. Remote or video onboarding is increasingly offered by certain banks (e.g., Techcombank, VPBank) for local entities, but for foreign-invested LLCs with non-resident ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs), banks uniformly impose an in-person interview requirement for at least the first signatory to complete biometric verification and to address AML red flags. The effective mandate is therefore: physical appearance of at least one director (or authorized representative) at the bank office in Vietnam, with all corporate and UBO documents notarized and, where necessary, legalized for Vietnam use.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign parent or ultimate beneficial owner registered in a low-tax or non-transparent jurisdiction (e.g., BVI, Seychelles, Hong Kong, UAE, or a jurisdiction without a tax information-exchange agreement with Vietnam).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Investor KYC file: certified copy of the investor's certificate of incorporation, constitutional documents, share register, register of directors, and beneficial ownership declaration (SBV/AML form 01-BO-E). Notarized Vietnamese translations. Power of attorney for the local signatory, with outstanding validity. Source-of-funds statement supported by the investor's audited financial statements for the last two years, bank reference letters, and a legal opinion from the investor's counsel confirming lawful origin of capital. Evidence of any intra-group transaction structure and a clear business-purpose narrative aligned with the ISIC 7410 design-subscription scope.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-value subscription receipts from distributed overseas clients without identifiable corporate counterparties, raising potential money-laundering and terrorist-financing concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Client-side KYC and transaction package: master client registry with beneficial-ownership detail for institutional clients; stored customer identification records for individual subscribers under the applicable data-protection law; reconciled billing system log from Stripe/Wise/Payoneer showing payouts; contractual terms of service; detailed invoices aligned with SBV service-export transaction codes; server-side metrics evidencing actual user interface/UX design subscription delivery; documented service-delivery workflow; registered domain and trademark certificates; and a written narrative explaining the digital-design-as-a-service model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments to non-resident UI/UX subcontractors or intellectual-property licensors in multiple foreign jurisdictions, creating potential misclassification of service fees or royalty withholding irregularities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Subcontracting and IP licensing agreements with payment schedules and territorial scope; deliverables acceptance certificates; work-log or project-management records; evidence of professional registration of the counterparty; tax opinions addressing the characterization of payments as royalties or technical service fees; proof of withholding tax (Form 01/NTNN or tax code filings); transfer-pricing documentation (Local File) showing arm's-length compensation; and reconciliation of payments to foreign contractors through authorized bank transfer advice notes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound equity injection from a jurisdiction with ambiguous source-of-funds or from an entity whose stated business is inconsistent with an investment in a Vietnamese design-subscription LLC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital-call/board resolution; updated Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC); direct investment capital account (DICA) details; remittance confirmation via SWIFT MT103 with precise purpose code referencing charter-capital contribution; foreign investment monitoring report submission reference to SBV; investor board minutes approving the capital contribution; audited financial statements of the remitting investor; bank-to-bank reference confirming the lawful source of funds; and, where applicable, registration of the shareholder loan under SBV rules.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between the declared ISIC 7410 design-subscription scope and actual treasury flows, such as unexplained transfers to unrelated persons or receipts from high-risk geographic regions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive treasury ledger: invoice-payment reconciliation log; complete client contracts; separate client acceptance and delivery records; annual audited financial statements; regulatory filing confirmations for service-export transactions; proof of fixed place of business in Vietnam (office lease or virtual-office registration, where allowed); staff employment contracts and social-insurance records; evidence of hardware/software assets used for the design business; and a sensitive-country/customer screening report demonstrating no prohibited counterparties.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All foreign-direct-investment capital for the LLC must be routed through a Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) opened at an authorized commercial bank in Vietnam, in VND or a permitted foreign currency. The LLC must first obtain the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC), and then the bank will open the DICA and register the foreign-investment capital schedule with the SBV's monitoring system. The foreign investor must issue a capital-call notice and board resolution specifying the exact amount and currency. The remittance must be sent via SWIFT MT103 with the correct foreign-exchange transaction purpose code (the charter-capital contribution code per the SBV reporting directory). Upon credit, the bank will issue a purpose-code confirmation or foreign-exchange certificate; the funds may be transferred to the operational account only after the bank verifies the documentary package (IRC, ERC, capital call, and investor KYC). Shareholder loans require prior registration with the SBV or the authorized bank and must be credited to the DICA under the loan purpose code; the loan agreement, SBV loan registration confirmation, and drawdown notice are mandatory.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing_note: For typical FDI LLCs, the minimum capital to complete banking onboarding is not statutorily fixed for ISIC 7410, but the bank's internal policies may require an authorized capital sufficient to cover estimated operating expenses and to demonstrate business viability. The LLC should establish an authorized capital aligned with its first-year subscription-revenue forecast to avoid unnecessary capital-contribution obstacles.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For the design-subscription business, outbound payments primarily comprise service fees to overseas design contractors, software licensing fees, royalties, and dividend repatriations. The standard clearing rail is an international wire via SWIFT MT103, executed by the authorized bank against a supporting set: underlying service/IP contract, invoice, proof of delivery or acceptance, board resolution, and declaration/certificate of Vietnamese tax withholding where required. A Commercial Letter of Credit (LC) is not a customary or suitable rail for service exports; settlement is effected on an open-account basis using MT103. For low-value subscription payouts, the LLC may use digital facilitators (e.g., Wise, Stripe) to initiate payments, but final treasury and regulatory reporting must remain on the authorized bank's books; the LLC must reconcile every payout with the corresponding service-export transaction code and ensure that all inbound collections are repatriated within the 90-day statutory window.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements_note: Payments to foreign contractors are subject to Vietnamese withholding tax (Foreign Contractor Tax) where applicable; the bank will require a letter of authorization and evidence of withholding tax payment before executing the international transfer. Dividends remitted to a foreign shareholder require audited financial statements, a dividend-resolution, tax clearance certificate from the General Department of Taxation, and a written request using the profit-repatriation purpose code.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable foreign-currency forward contract with a licensed bank, tenor up to 365 days, tied to a genuine USD/VND cash flow from export subscriptions or foreign-currency liabilities (per SBV Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN). Non-deliverable forward (NDF) structures are not permitted onshore for VND.
Onshore foreign-currency swap (FX swap) between VND and a major convertible currency, used for short-term treasury liquidity bridging and rollover of USD receivables into VND working-capital needs.

Onshore foreign-currency option contracts (call/put) with physical delivery, entered into with an authorized bank, provided the options are supported by an underlying current-account or capital-account exposure and are not speculative (subject to the bank's internal product authorization).

Cross-currency interest-rate swap (CCIRS) for the hedging of a long-term USD-denominated shareholder loan, available at major banks after credit approval and demonstration of the underlying borrowing and repayment schedule.

Forward agreements on the interbank FX market are not available to non-bank customers; all hedging must be executed bilaterally with an authorized commercial bank under express SBV FX-regulatory frameworks.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Registration Report (Bao cao tinh hinh hoat dong doanh nghiep) - annual update of legal representative, members, registered address, and business lines
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: District-level Business Registration Office under the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI), submitted via the National Enterprise Registration Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 January for the preceding calendar year (Decree 01/2021/ND-CP, Article 76)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing: administrative fine of VND 10,000,000-15,000,000 (approx. USD 410-615) under Decree 50/2016/ND-CP; failure to report material changes within 10 days: fine up to VND 30,000,000; persistent non-filing for 2 consecutive years exposes the LLC to revocation of Enterprise Registration Certificate and administrative strike-off under Law on Enterprises 2020.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Duty (le phi mon bai) - annual business license tax based on charter capital
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Taxation (Cuc Thue / Chi cuc Thue) via the e-tax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 January; for newly registered LLC, within 30 days of issuance of Enterprise Registration Certificate (year-one exemption for new enterprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of VND 4,000,000-6,000,000 (approx. USD 165-245) plus late-payment interest at 0.03% per day; chronic arrearage triggers tax enforcement measures and suspension or involuntary administrative strike-off of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements (audited, mandatory for foreign-invested enterprise) and Annual Corporate Income Tax / Personal Income Tax finalization returns (Quyet toan thue TNDN/TNCN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Taxation, Department of Planning and Investment (DPI), and Provincial Statistics Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end; for calendar-year entities: by 31 March; audited financial statements must also be lodged to the DPI for the FIE within the same 90-day window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late submission fines of up to VND 20,000,000-30,000,000 (approx. USD 820-1,230) under tax administration law; unpaid tax bears late-payment interest at 0.03% per day; failure of an FIE to file audited financial statements triggers administrative penalties and may be treated as omitted-tax evidence leading to CIT reassessment.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory audit is not revenue-based for this entity: every foreign-invested enterprise (FIE) in Vietnam is compulsorily subject to independent audit each fiscal year under the Law on Independent Audit 2011 and Decree 17/2014/ND-CP (as amended by Decree 89/2019/ND-CP), regardless of turnover; audit exemptions apply only to certain domestic-owned SMEs below equity and turnover thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS / Vietnamese GAAP) per Law on Accounting 2015 (88/2015/QH13) and Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC; an FIE may additionally apply IFRS for parent-consolidation reporting if approved by the Ministry of Finance.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering 2022 (Law 14/2022/QH13) and Decree 19/2023/ND-CP, the LLC must identify, record, and continuously update beneficial owners (individuals owning or controlling 25% or more of charter capital or voting rights, or controlling appointment of managers). Any transfer of shares or member interests must be reflected in a member-list amendment and notified to the Business Registration Office within 10 days; annual confirmation is discharged through the Annual Enterprise Registration Report (due 31 January) containing updated member and ownership structures. No separate UBO filing fee applies; for this Low_Risk_Standard design-as-a-service model, standard customer due diligence applies rather than enhanced AML reporting.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (list of capital-contributing members with ownership percentages)
Book of Minutes and Resolutions of the Members' Council and General Meetings
Accounting books, vouchers, contracts, and annual financial statements (retained for 10 years)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300-800 per annum (market range for a registered office or legal-address service in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City for a foreign-invested LLC, including notice handling and annual return coordination)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500-5,000 per annum (typical certified audit fee for a small FIE service or design LLC with modest transaction volume)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No automatic statutory tax holiday applies to ISIC 7410 (UI/UX design subscription services). The standard 20% CIT rate applies unless the LLC obtains an Investment Registration Certificate qualifying it for preferential rates: 10% for 15 years for high-technology enterprises, software production, and certain encouraged sectors; 17% for 10 years for qualifying projects in economically difficult zones; plus conditional CIT exemption/reduction periods (e.g., 2-year exemption and 50% reduction for 4 years) for new encouraged projects. Design-as-a-service activities are generally not eligible unless specifically certified as high-tech/software services.
